df-001: Chat prompt and tool context sent to the configured LLM endpoint (HTTP) df-001 authentication: LLM_API_KEY environment value passed as provider apiKey; evidence: routes/chat.ts:110
df-002: Server-side fetch of user-supplied profile image URL (HTTP)
df-003: WebSocket RPC subscription to NFTMinted and ContractExploited contract events (WebSocket) df-003 authentication: ALCHEMY_API_KEY embedded in wss URL path; evidence: routes/nftMint.ts:18

df-004: Sequelize ORM queries against SQLite file or in-memory database (SQLite) df-004 authentication: Embedded SQLite engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: models/index.ts:34

df-005: Login SQL query matching email and hashed password (SQLite) df-005 authentication: Embedded SQLite engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: models/index.ts:34

df-006: Login request with email and password; response returns session token (HTTP) df-006 authentication: Email and password in request body checked against Users table; evidence: routes/login.ts:34

df-007: Socket.IO events: challenge verification and notification acknowledgements; server emits challenge notifications (Socket.IO) df-007 authentication: Socket.IO connection handler performs no credential check; evidence: lib/startup/registerWebsocketEvents.ts:23

df-008: OAuth authorization (HTTPS) df-008 authentication: The identity provider authenticates the user at its sign-in endpoint; evidence: frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:31, frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148
df-009: OAuth profile request (HTTPS) df-009 authentication: The provider checks the OAuth access token sent with the request; evidence: frontend/src/app/Services/user.service.ts:68

df-010: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-010 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/checkKeys.ts:34, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186

df-011: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-012: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-013: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-011 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:52, routes/dataExport.ts:18, routes/orderHistory.ts:13, lib/insecurity.ts:156 df-011 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-012 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/recycles.ts:23, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186 df-012 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-013 authentication: token decoded without signature verification; evidence: routes/chat.ts:223 df-013 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-015: API requests (bearer) (HTTP) df-016: API requests (none) (HTTP) df-015 authentication: the handler checks a bearer credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:52 df-015 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a df-016 authentication: no credential check in the resolved handler chain; evidence: routes/login.ts:18, server.ts:197, server.ts:203, routes/metrics.ts:63, lib/antiCheat.ts:51, server.ts:315, routes/verify.ts:84, lib/insecurity.ts:186 df-016 access group: API access; alternatives; step n/a

df-018: Direct requests (cookie) (HTTP) df-018 authentication: the handler checks a cookie credential and rejects the request without it; evidence: routes/profileImageFileUpload.ts:35, routes/profileImageUrlUpload.ts:21, routes/userProfile.ts:34, routes/updateUserProfile.ts:17, routes/dataErasure.ts:26, routes/dataErasure.ts:76

g.text: data flow · classification colour · two heads = bidirectional
trust boundary crossed between these columns
trust change within a column (dashed: inferred)
dashed outline = zone, not itself a boundary
solid = direct attack · dashed = via user
STRIDE category: filled = findings in that category
All Critical · High fills to 5 · +N = omitted High categories
counts on a node = threats per severity · ①–⑨ = attack scenario
badges also count scenarios that hit an asset stored there
Dynamic code evaluation = runs runtime data as program code
Most security-critical functions always shown (at most 5), others up
to 3 labels per element: most critical first, then most severe linked
finding; +N = further labels, listed under Further capabilities.
Functions may go undetected: a missing label does not mean absence.
Profile name evaluated as server code

The recipient checks the supplied password.

A session cookie identifies the caller.
The caller presents a configured service credential.
Delegated access; only the evidenced protocol step is covered.
Authentication could not be determined from the code.
Numbered hexagon: authentication · circle: attack scenario
Red: absent / unsafe · yellow: standard / limited · green: stronger
Method properties, not proof of a secure implementation.
